pr_title: Allow arbitrary digests with ECDSA and DSA
pr_body:
Unless the FIPS security check is enabled we allow arbitrary digests
with ECDSA and DSA.

Fixes #14696
pr_comments: I don't understand how the change from NID_undef to -1 for a disapproved digest made any difference. Care to explain?

> I don't understand how the change from NID_undef to -1 for a disapproved digest made any difference. Care to explain?

The difference is that we simply continue if NID_undef is returned. And, when FIPS security check is enabled, we return -1 instead of NID_undef if disapproved digest is encountered.

We still do not support disapproved digests when ALGORITHM_ID is needed and that is IMO OK as that would not work with 1.1.1 either.

> Approved once the 's' is added to the documentation.

Done

issue_context.title: EC keys do not allow arbitrary digest when signing
issue_context.body:
This is offspring of #14052

It was possible to use for example SM3 digest with EVP EC key to do ECDSA. It is not possible anymore.
comments: OTC: We should not break behaviour compared to 1.1.1

@levitte was asking for a cmdline test:

~~~
$ openssl version
OpenSSL 3.0.0-alpha15 22 Apr 2021 (Library: OpenSSL 3.0.0-alpha15 22 Apr 2021)
$ openssl genpkey -algorithm EC -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 > key.pem
$ openssl dgst -hex -sign key.pem -shake256 /etc/lsb-release
Error setting context
8052A155B97F0000:error:068000A8:asn1 encoding routines:asn1_check_tlen:wrong tag:crypto/asn1/tasn_dec.c:1156:
8052A155B97F0000:error:0688010A:asn1 encoding routines:asn1_item_embed_d2i:nested asn1 error:crypto/asn1/tasn_dec.c:322:Type=X509_ALGOR
8052A155B97F0000:error:0688010A:asn1 encoding routines:asn1_template_noexp_d2i:nested asn1 error:crypto/asn1/tasn_dec.c:653:Field=algor, Type=X509_SIG
8052A155B97F0000:error:1C8000AE:Provider routines:ecdsa_setup_md:digest not allowed:providers/implementations/signature/ecdsa.c:231:digest=SHAKE256
~~~

review_comments: No, because this is exactly the change that allows doing arbitrary digests with ECDSA as in the reported bug #14696
This just makes it the same as ECDSA. I do not insist on that though as DSA is something legacy that should not be used with potential new digests anyway.
As below. Are you OK with keeping `<` to align DSA and ECDSA?
Sure.  I wasn't completely sure and the old code checked for NID_undef which is zero, so better to verify that this was the intention.
